storage.journalMissing: no migration journal at {{path}}: run `npm run db:generate` to produce it
storage.migrationFileMissing: migration "{{tag}}" is listed in the journal but {{path}} does not exist
storage.migrationChecksumMismatch: migration "{{tag}}" was already applied with different content: the database and the repository disagree, so the schema cannot be trusted
storage.storedRecordSchemaMismatch: stored {{kind}} "{{id}}" no longer matches the {{kind}} schema: {{reason}}

validation.messageTextTooLong: step "{{step}}" has {{found}} bytes of text, over the {{limit}} byte limit. The limit is in UTF-8 BYTES, not characters: every accented character costs two.
validation.confirmationWithoutQuickReply: step "{{step}}" asks for a confirmation and declares no button label. The text of the button is what counts as a yes: without one, no answer from the contact would confirm, and they would wait until the deadline runs out.
validation.stepWithoutWording: step "{{step}}" declares an empty list of wordings, and a step that sends text needs at least one. Delete the step, or write the wording it sends.
validation.triggerIncompatible: step "{{step}}" replies to a comment, but this automation starts from a direct message, where there is no comment to reply to.
validation.duplicateButtonId: button id "{{id}}" appears twice in the same card, and an id is what a click is attributed to: two buttons sharing one would merge their histories.
validation.buttonDestinationDeclaredTwice: step "{{step}}" declares button "{{id}}" with an address AND a file of the catalogue, and a button opens exactly one destination. Keep the address, or keep the file: sending both would make the tap go somewhere nobody chose.
validation.messageWithoutContent: step "{{step}}" sends a message with nothing in it. Write the text, add a button, or add a link: an empty message is one the contact never receives.
validation.tooManyLinks: step "{{step}}" declares {{found}} links, over the {{limit}} one delivery carries. Each pure link arrives as a message of its own, so a fourth would be a fifth message in a row.
validation.tooManyButtons: step "{{step}}" declares {{found}} buttons, over the {{limit}} a card carries. The platform's template accepts {{limit}}, and the ones past that would simply not be delivered.
validation.coverWithoutButton: step "{{step}}" declares a cover image and no button. The cover belongs to the card, and it is the button that makes the message a card: add a button, or drop the cover. A pure link makes no card, however many there are.
validation.cardDescriptionTooLong: step "{{step}}" has a card description of {{found}} characters, over the {{limit}} character limit of the template.
validation.cardTitleDeclaredTwice: step "{{step}}" declares both a text and a card title, and with a button the text IS the title. Keep one of the two, or the other would be sent nowhere.
validation.scopeTriggerMismatch: the declared scope and trigger target describe different publications.

suppressed.conversation_already_open: the confirmation was not asked: the contact had written recently, so the conversation was already open
suppressed.email_already_known: the address was not asked for: this contact had already given one, and it is still stored
suppressed.contact_already_follows: nothing was asked at the follow requirement: the contact already follows the account
suppressed.automation_already_delivered: nothing was delivered and the run stopped here: another run of this same automation had already delivered to this contact, and the once-per-contact rule is on

failed.flow_not_runnable: the run stopped before its first step: no definition of this flow is in force, or the one in force was refused
failed.execution_belongs_to_another_flow: the run stopped: it was picked up under a flow other than the one it started in
failed.current_step_not_declared: the run stopped: the step it had reached is no longer in the definition it was running
failed.transition_target_not_declared: the run stopped: one step leads to another that the definition does not declare
failed.transitions_form_a_cycle: the run stopped: the steps lead back into each other and never reach an end
failed.step_type_unsupported: the step was not performed: this build does not know how to perform a step of that kind
failed.pause_without_duration: the pause never started: it declares no length, and a pause of nothing would fire the next step in the same instant
failed.confirmation_without_button: the confirmation was not asked: the step declares no button label, and without one there is no answer the contact could give to confirm
failed.comment_reply_without_comment: the reply was not sent: this run did not come from a comment, so there was nothing to answer
failed.unexpected_error: the step stopped on an error raised outside the engine, and what was answered is recorded beside this line, as it arrived

dispatch.alreadyRan: automation "{{automation}}" has already delivered to this contact: the once-per-contact rule is on, and the mark is written by the run that hands the material over
dispatch.bindingRefused: automation "{{automation}}" could not be bound to its flow, so no step ran: {{issues}}
dispatch.resumeLostAutomation: execution "{{execution}}" was waiting for the contact, but the automation that started it no longer exists: nothing was delivered
dispatch.resumeAutomationInactive: execution "{{execution}}" was waiting for the contact, but its automation is no longer active: nothing was delivered

suspension.timedOut: the contact did not answer before the deadline: the execution ends through the flow's declared "{{policy}}" path
suspension.consumedByResume: the message ended a suspended execution and was not offered to trigger matching: it would otherwise start a second run beside the one it unblocked
suspension.answerRefused: the message reached a suspended execution but is not the answer the step is waiting for: the execution stays suspended at that same step, and the message goes on to trigger matching, which is what an answer the wait refused was always free to be
suspension.answerRefusedAsking: the message reached a suspended execution but is not the answer the step is waiting for: it goes on to trigger matching first, and the question is asked again as attempt {{attempt}} of {{max}} only if no automation takes the contact over; short of that the execution stays suspended at that same step under the same deadline
suspension.attemptsExhausted: the contact answered {{attempts}} times and never with what the step asked for, so the attempts allowed by the flow are spent: the execution ends through the flow's declared "{{policy}}" path, the same one a missed deadline takes, the question is not asked again, and the message itself goes on to trigger matching like any other
suspension.superseded: the contact triggered automation "{{automation}}", and the last automation triggered is the one that holds them: this earlier execution ends where it was suspended, having delivered nothing, and what it had already queued still goes out, because those messages were promised before this trigger existed

instance.closingMessage: No problem. Whenever you feel like it, just comment again.

follow.stillNotFollowing: the contact wrote, and the platform still says they do not follow the account: nothing was delivered, and the request was not repeated, because the next message they send is checked again; the message goes on to trigger matching, so another automation may take the contact from this requirement
follow.notVerified: the follow relationship could not be verified ({{cause}}): the requirement stays closed and nothing was delivered, because a gate that opens on a query it could not make gives away a resource nobody can take back; the message goes on to trigger matching, so another automation may take the contact from this requirement
follow.stillNotFollowingResent: the contact wrote, and the platform still says they do not follow the account: the request was sent again, button included, because the contact's own message takes the button off their screen; nothing was delivered, and there is no ceiling on how often this may be asked for, only the deadline
follow.notVerifiedResent: the contact wrote and the follow relationship could not be verified ({{cause}}): the request was sent again, button included, so they can ask once more; the requirement stays closed and nothing was delivered
follow.stillNotFollowingRecheck: We checked and you still do not follow this account. Follow it, then tap the button below.
follow.notVerifiedRecheck: We checked, but could not verify whether you follow this account. Please follow it, then tap the button below.

window.outsideWindow: outside the {{window}} delivery window for an execution of origin {{origin}}, counted from {{since}}: nothing was sent to the platform

rate.deferredByCap: deferred by the {{cap}} cap: nothing was discarded, the send is delivered when the window allows
rate.rateLimited: the platform answered too many requests
rate.uncertainDelivery: gave up after the platform answered an error it may still have delivered: {{reason}}. Retrying would risk sending the same message twice to the same person.

publication.malformedResponse: the platform answered with a body this build cannot read

credential.refreshFailed: could not renew the platform credential: {{reason}}. Deliveries stop when it expires.
credential.unusable: the platform credential no longer works ({{reason}}). Deliveries have stopped until it is replaced.

status.credentialMissing: platform credential: not configured (a fresh installation, nothing is broken)
status.credentialNeverExpires: expires at: never (this path issues a token with no expiry)

app.listening: MyChat is listening on port {{port}}. The platform reaches it at {{origin}}: webhook {{webhook}}, resources {{assets}}.
app.credentialSeeded: platform credential stored from the environment, assumed valid until {{expiresAt}}. From here on the automatic renewal owns it, and a restart never overwrites it.

auth.passwordMismatch: The two entries do not match. Nothing was changed.
auth.passwordTooShort: The password must be at least {{minimum}} characters long. Nothing was changed.
auth.passwordReplaced: Operator password replaced. The previous one no longer authenticates.
auth.insecureCookieInProduction: Refusing to start: {{variable}} is off while NODE_ENV is production, which would emit the session cookie without the `secure` mark and let a browser send it over plain HTTP. It may only be turned off in local development, which has no TLS.
auth.routeOutsidePrivateScope: Route "{{url}}" was registered inside the private scope, and only addresses under {{prefixes}} may be private. A public route behind the session check answers a refusal instead of doing its job, and when that route is the webhook the deliveries stop with no visible error.
auth.attemptsThrottled: Authentication attempts from {{origin}} went past the configured limit and are refused until {{retryAt}}. The password was not checked: while the block lasts, even the correct one is refused.

automation.pendingPublicationSyncUnavailable: could not synchronize the publication catalogue
automation.autoPaused: automation {{id}} was paused after three definitive delivery failures within ten minutes: {{reason}}

automations.followQuestionTip: The words that travel beside the button, in the inbox.
automations.openingSettings: The reply deadline and the number of questions live in Settings, the same for every automation.
automations.messageBodyTip: What the person receives in the inbox as soon as the conversation opens.
automations.addPartsTip: Two forms, and they deliver different things. A pure link arrives as a message of its own, right after yours, and the preview under it is drawn by the destination site: a YouTube video or a Substack article arrive with their own cover. A button turns the whole message into a card, and it is the button that delivers a file, an image or a PDF.

automations.buttonDestinationTip: One or the other, never both: an address that already exists, or a file that goes up to our own CDN.
automations.buttonUrlTip: The address it opens when tapped.
automations.buttonAssetHint: Choose or upload a PDF or an image. It stays with us, and the button opens its address.
automations.linksWhy: Each link arrives as a message of its own, right after yours. The preview is drawn by the destination site, and that is the one thing a button does not do.
automations.linkAddressTip: The address that travels on its own, so the site can draw its preview.
automations.deliveryShapeEmpty: Write the message the person will receive.

automations.firstReplyDelayTip: It holds the FIRST reply only, the one that goes out the instant the trigger fires: the public reply on the comment, where there is one, and the first direct message, which leave together. What comes after the person answers, the e-mail question and the delivery, waits for nothing.

automations.firstReplyEchoImmediate: The reply goes out in the same instant the trigger fires, with no pause at all.
